text:
Predicates:
WorksInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromComputerScienceDept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakesDatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedByProfessorD(x) ::: x is instructed by professor David.
WorksInLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Year1946 ::: the year 1946.
Published(y, 1946) ::: y is published in 1946.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Love(x, y) ::: x loves y.
Miroslav ::: Miroslav Venhoda.
Music ::: the concept of music.
Czech(x) ::: x is Czech.
ChoralConductor(x) ::: x is a choral conductor.

Premises:
¬∃x (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x) ∧ ¬FromComputerScienceDept(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ HasPartTimeJob(x)) → WorksInLibrary(x)) ::: All students with part-time jobs offered by the university work in the library.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ TakesDatabaseCourse(x)) → FromComputerScienceDept(x) ::: All students taking the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (InstructedByProfessorD(x)) → TakesDatabaseCourse(x) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (WorksInLab(x)) → InstructedByProfessorD(x) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
Student(James) ::: James is a student.
WorksInLab(James) ::: James works in the lab.
Jack ::: Jack.
¬HasPartTimeJob(Jack) ::: Jack does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
¬WorksInLab(Jack) ::: Jack does not work in the lab.

Conclusion:
HasPartTimeJob(James) ::: James has a part-time job offered by the university.
